sections.en: Despite the toxic content and high pressure of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s atmosphere, strong life signs have been detected coming from its surface.

texts.zh: 虽对大多数生物都有毒性，[From.GetName]的高气压大气层也同样存在生机勃勃的生态环境。这里的生物用氨水而不是水来作为溶剂，并因此发展出了与其他地区截然不同的生态特征。对它们的研究会极大的丰富对异星生物学的了解。
texts.en: Although toxic to most forms of known life, [From.GetName] supports a thriving ecology within the high pressure of its atmosphere. Life here uses ammonia instead of water as a solvent, and has developed in ways that differ significantly from previously established ecological models. Its study would greatly benefit our knowledge of xeno biology.

texts.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的有毒大气层内观测到的生命信号，是体型庞大的半有机机械体！这个外星工业体似乎正是星球上乌烟瘴气的罪魁祸首，而且它依旧在运转。这个星球上没有其他的生命信号，这些机械体的造物主肯定抛下它们自己跑掉了。我们目前还不能确定它们的意图，但是它们建造的建筑想必能够帮助我们更好地理解工程学。
texts.en: The life signs observed within the toxic atmosphere of [From.GetName] are giant semi-organic machines! This alien industry seems to have been the cause of the noxious atmosphere on the planet, yet it's still operational. No other life signs remain on the world, and the creators of these machines must have left them running. We can't quite ascertain their purpose yet, but their construction could surely help our understanding of engineering.

texts.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的有毒大气层内观测到的生命信号，是体型庞大的半有机机械体！正如我们一样，看上去这个设施的创造者也很青睐生物和机械的融合之美。这个外星工业体似乎正是星球上乌烟瘴气的罪魁祸首，而且它依旧在运转。这个星球上没有其他的生命信号，这些机械体的造物主肯定抛下它们自己跑掉了。我们目前还不能确定它们的意图，但是它们建造的建筑想必能够帮助我们更好地理解工程学。
texts.en: The life signs observed within the toxic atmosphere of [From.GetName] are giant semi-organic machines! Like us, it seems like the creators of this facility appreciated a merging of the biological and mechanical. This alien industry appears to have been the cause of the noxious atmosphere on the planet, yet it's still operational. No other life signs remain on the world, and the creators of these machines must have left them running. We can't quite ascertain their purpose yet, but their construction could surely help our understanding of engineering.

summary.text:
# 生命迹象 / Life Signs

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/00_anomaly_categories.txt:506; events/anomaly_events_1.txt:4718 (anomaly.690); events/anomaly_events_4.txt:3302 (anomaly.6895)

## 如何开始 How it starts

没有战略资源的有毒星球可能生成（2级，权重3）。

Can spawn on a toxic planet without a strategic resource (level 2, weight 3).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

anomaly.690“氨生物圈”（社会矿藏 d_society_3 + ammonia_biosphere 修正，标本 ammoniaphytus，2天后 story.1）与 anomaly.6895“有毒的生物工业”（清除矿藏后四种选项：d_engineering_4；非催化帝国 d_alloys_3；催化帝国 d_alloys_5；田园/灵性/排外帝国 d_society_4；前三项记录标本 toxic_bio_engine）。

anomaly.690 "Ammonia Biosphere" (d_society_3 plus ammonia_biosphere, specimen ammoniaphytus, story.1 after 2 days) and anomaly.6895 "Toxic Biological Industry" (deposits cleared; options: d_engineering_4; d_alloys_3 for non-catalytic empires; d_alloys_5 for catalytic empires; d_society_4 for Agrarian Idyll / spiritualist / xenophobe empires; the first three record specimen toxic_bio_engine).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

两个结果互斥，各50%。

The results are exclusive, 50% each.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

anomaly.6895 的描述与选项按催化帝国、田园生活公民、灵性与排外倾向变化。

anomaly.6895's description and options vary with catalytic status, the Agrarian Idyll civic, spiritualist and xenophobe.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常定义与全部结果事件；编译树正确，无需改动。

Checked the anomaly definition and every outcome event; the compiled tree is correct, no change needed.
